title: review code edits / Review changes by comparing diffs
content: ## Review changes by comparing diffs For Claude or Codex harness sessions in the editor window, the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, and cloud sessions, compare diffs instead of keeping or undoing pending edits. In the editor window, a pill above the chat input shows the number of affected files and diff statistics. {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness sessions can use this presentation by selecting **Show Pill** from the working set context menu. Use any of these review options: * Select the changed-files pill to open a multi-diff editor with all changes. * Select a changed file in the agent's response to open its diff. * In the editor, use the [Source Control view](/docs/sourcecontrol/staging-commits.md) to review changed and untracked files when the folder uses Git. ### Review changes in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} 1. Open the **Changes** view in the side panel by using the layout controls in the title bar, or use the `kb(workbench.action.toggleAuxiliaryBar)` keyboard shortcut. 1. Select a file in the **Changes** view to open a diff of the agent's edits. **Other Files** groups edits outside the workspace, such as session plans, which aren't committed with workspace changes. Also check Source Control for untracked files and changes made outside tracked edit tools. > [!TIP] > Use the **Branch Changes** dropdown to choose which changeset to review. 1. Select **Mark as Reviewed** in a file's toolbar to track files you've reviewed in the **Branch Changes** changeset. The reviewed state clears if you or the agent changes the file again. ### Review cloud changes Review the session's pull request on GitHub, or check out its branch locally to inspect and revise the changes. ### Customize change review in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} By default, selecting a file in the **Changes** view opens a multi-file diff editor with all the session changes. To open a focused single-file diff, enable `setting(sessions.changes.openSingleFileDiff)`. Use the diff toolbar to show the editor beside chat or in a modal window. Select **More Actions** (**...**) > **Diff View** to choose **Inline**, **Side by Side**, or **Automatic**. **Automatic** switches to inline when the editor is too narrow for side-by-side diffs. #### Configure word wrap in diff editors `feature(agents-window-word-wrap)` Control how diff editors in the **Changes** view wrap long lines with `setting(sessions.diffEditor.wordWrap)`. This setting has the following values: * `inherit` (default): Follow the `setting(editor.wordWrap)` setting. * `on`: Wrap lines at the editor viewport width. * `off`: Never wrap lines. This setting is independent of [word wrap in code editors](/docs/agents/run/agents-window-configuration.md#configure-word-wrap-for-code-editors). To change it from a diff editor, select **More Actions** (**...**) > **Word Wrap**. #### Review changes in the single-pane layout (Experimental) When you enable the [experimental single-pane editor panel](/docs/agents/run/agents-window-configuration.md#use-the-single-pane-editor-panel-experimental), the **Changes** view and diff editor share one docked pane. Use **Expand All Diffs** or **Collapse All Diffs** to control all files at once. The `kb(toggle.diff.renderSideBySide)` keybinding toggles the preferred diff view in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. The Changes editor restores each file's expanded or collapsed state when you switch sessions or reload the window. The editor tab title shows the next integration action, such as **Create Pull Request**, and switches to an icon when space is limited.
